svg.title: Wide grapheme alpha-blending test map
svg.desc: Twelve panels illustrating the current wide-grapheme alpha-blending contract: wide text is preserved through interior translucent fills, wide emoji are replaced with [] placeholders, scissor clipping only updates cells inside the clip, boundary-band fills clip crossed spans with fillRectClipWideGraphemes, and renderer repaints preclear placeholder spans before restoring emoji and following cells.
svg.text: WG = wide text. EM = wide emoji. Lavender = original wide text. Gold = original emoji. Orange = translucent overlay.
Pale green = overlay-filled cell. Mint = preserved wide text. Rose = [] placeholder. Blue = clipped edge fill.

g.text: wide emoji become [] instead of bleeding through
second space is skipped, not re-blended
cursor resets after the gap between spans
fillRect() must not bleed outside clip
only the clipped cell may change
crossed span is cleared; only the inside cell fills
mirrored edge case: right half stays untouched
a clipped write must not suppress a later full one
later full write still reaches the start cell
crossed span is cleared at the edge
fully interior wide text stays visible
placeholder span repaints back to emoji
renderer clears the old span first
